visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short black hair and glasses sits on a brown leather sofa, wearing a light blue ribbed sweater. Her expression is awkward and hesitant as she repeatedly taps her index fingers together in a shy gesture. A pink and white text box floating above her head displays characters indicating an introverted persona. The background is a dark studio wall with small framed pictures. (2) The woman suddenly turns her head 90 degrees to her right and shifts her expression to a bright, energetic smile. She points toward the right side of the frame with a playful, confident gesture. The floating text box changes to a teal color with characters representing an extroverted persona. She appears outgoing and highly expressive, directly contrasting with her previous shy posture. (3) The scene transitions to a vertical screen recording of a smartphone application interface. A yellow rubber chick toy is positioned on a wooden desk in front of a white Logitech keyboard. The app interface shows various photography settings such as 'INSTANT', 'WAIT', and '10' for photo count. Yellow animated highlights and a pointer follow the user's interaction as they select specific timing and burst mode options. (4) The camera returns to a medium shot of the woman sitting on the leather sofa. She speaks directly into the camera with a friendly, informative expression, using hand gestures to emphasize her points. The lighting is bright and even studio lighting, clearly illuminating her face and the textures of her sweater and the leather couch. (5) A smartphone screen is held up to the camera, showing a live camera preview where the woman is seen posing with her hands behind her head. A yellow 'CENTER GUIDE' box overlay appears on the app interface to help with framing. The woman strikes several dynamic poses while the app automatically captures her, demonstrating the utility of the timer and framing features. (6) A series of high-speed still photos of the woman in different playful poses flash rapidly across the screen in a montage style. The final shot shows her sitting at the wooden table, pointing directly at the lens with a wink and a mischievous grin, effectively concluding the demonstration with a high-energy and engaging social-media style outro.
